thread:
people-ops: Heads-up team — Handbook v3.0 is live. Major items: updated parental leave matrix, single-source guidance for customer data handling, and a clarified process for remote office stipend. We9re launching a short mandatory refresher only for employees/contractors whose role has changed or who have prod/customer-data access. Estimated time: 15-25 minutes. Deadline: 2026-06-01.

Links:
• Handbook v3.0: https://handbook.redwood.ai/v3.0
• Refresher module: https://learning.redwood.ai/courses/handbook-v3-refresher
• Manager tracker: https://sheets.redwood.ai/handbook/v3-tracker

Managers: please verify completion for direct reports in the tracker by the deadline. For external contractors that access production or customer data, they9ll be auto-enrolled. If a contractor is strictly sandbox/staging, request an exemption in the tracker with role scope and we9ll review.

dana: Quick Q — does this affect our offering letters re: parental leave? We send bundles to new hires next week.

people-ops: Good flag. We added an "offer addendum" snippet in the handbook appendix; use that link when you send offers. If you want a templated clause, ping us and we9ll share.

kevin: For the tracker export, can we get fields: manager, employment_type (FT/PT/contractor), last_cert_date, and exemption_flag? Needed for our people analytics run.

people-ops: Yes — export will include those columns. We9ll publish a CSV on 2026-06-02. If you need a pre-filtered export (by team or contractor vendor), DM the filter spec.

hrbot: Reminder scheduled — "Handbook v3.0 refresher due" 2026-05-25 09:00 PDT. :bell: Automated nudges will go to folks with outstanding items.

mika: If someone completed the v2.x refresher last year and their responsibilities haven9t changed, do they need to retake?

people-ops: If their scope/access hasn9t changed, upload last year9s certificate to the tracker and tag us. We9ll grandfather those entries after a quick review. Deadline to request grandfathering: 2026-05-20.

jamal: Legal note: vendors with limited PII access but who have signing access to release notes should still do the course. Please DM contracts@redwood.ai for vendor-specific determinations.

kevin: Who audits the manager-marked completions? We have a few managers who bulk-marked previously.

people-ops: We9ll run a targeted audit sampling 10% of manager-marked entries. Managers must attach proof (certificate or attendance list) when marking. The tracker has an "evidence_url" column.

dana: Can managers add external contractors not present in HRIS? We have one vendor rep who9s not in HRIS yet.

people-ops: Yes — add them to the tracker manually and attach evidence. We can ingest those records for compliance but note that billing/SLAs still require HRIS enrollment for longer-term vendors.

kevin: Will completion be reflected in performance dashboards? We need to include compliance as part of calibration packets.

people-ops: Completion will be a compliance attribute visible in the perf dashboard. We9ll also provide a manager CSV export for calibration by 2026-06-02. Noncompliance triggers manager outreach; repeated noncompliance will be escalated to HR.

mika: How long do we retain completion records? Accounting asked for retention windows for audit.

people-ops: We retain completion records for 7 years per policy. For audit extracts, email compliance@redwood.ai with your export spec.

eo-bot: Note: added a short FAQ and manager checklist to the channel resources thread.

kevin: Thanks all — I9ll request the export with manager and contractor flags.

people-ops: Thanks — we9ll follow up if there are edge cases. Please escalate access or tracker permission issues via #help.
